Water breaks and a short update
The desk is glad to help after dinner
Travelers, please note that pet check-in at Aurelia Skyways may need extra care today, so plan a little more room in your visit and keep your documents ready.

Companion Animal Travel Desk update
We are sorry for any delay, and we want every animal to move through the trip safely and calmly. <<FACT F017>> Please keep carriers secure, use the pet relief area before arrival, and follow staff directions if your route changes. The desk checks each booking with care, from the first request to pickup, because safety matters more than speed.

If you are traveling with a cat, dog, or another approved companion, make sure the carrier is clean, closed, and easy to carry. <<FACT F007>> Bring any papers you have been asked to show, and let us know right away if your pet needs special support. If you are worried about a connection, stop by early so the team can review the next steps with you.

We appreciate your patience and understanding while we work to keep the process smooth for all travelers. Please speak with the Companion Animal Travel Desk for help before you head onward.
